notes.title: Cryptfall Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Jx5fwly3yPo;full][/previewyoutube]

Great news! The Cryptfall Alpha Playtest is going live from February to March, and YOU'RE invited!
Some players have already ventured into the crypt, and watching their gameplay, content, and feedback has been a blast. Now it’s your turn!

Event Details:
📅 Starting February 10th – Drop Dead [TO BE CONFIRMED]
🪧 Sign-up [url=https://form.jotform.com/250340942727456]HERE[/url]

How To Join?
[list]
[*] Fill out this form [url=https://form.jotform.com/250340942727456]HERE[/url]
[*] We’ll reach out to you via email with a Steam key, an invitation to the Discord server, and instructions to download the build.
[/list]
What You Need to Know:
[list]
[*] It’s still in development – Expect rough edges, bugs, and unfinished content. Your feedback is critical!
[*] Streaming is allowed! We’d love to see your clips and share them with the community.
[*] Prepare to die. A lot. But hey, that’s half the fun!
[/list]

We would love for you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/p2JZUJ4hRW]Discord[/url] community and hear your feedback as we develop our game

A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has already tried the game, joined our Discord, and streamed the playtest! Your support and feedback mean the world to us. We can’t wait to have even more of you and share this journey together!
Now, back to fixing things before the cryptids fully awaken… Wish us luck!

Cheers!
